sheets.title: COVER SHEET
sheets.reading_notes: Project cover sheet showing drawing index with 8 sheets. Lists all project personnel including JLab team: C. Jones (SME/User), D. Sulouff (Design PM), S. Hoey (ES&H), T. Minga (Fire Protection Manager), S. Chandra (Design Manager), J. Dolbeck (Engineering Manager), R. Sprouse (FM&L Division Manager). Drawing number base 220013-.

sheets.title: LEGEND, NOTES AND ABBREVIATIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Mechanical legend defines symbols (thermostat, demolition mark, new work mark, condensate drain piping, refrigerant liquid and suction piping, ACCU-1 designation, AHU designation, ETR=existing to remain, pipe slope down). Abbreviations: ACC=Air Cooled Condensing Unit, AHU=Air Handling Unit. Project narrative embedded on sheet: 'THE PROJECT CONSISTS OF PROVIDING ADDITIONAL COOLING FOR ROOMS 109 & 110 OF F-WING, CEBAF CENTER, JEFFERSON LAB. EQUIPMENT WAS SIZED AS PER THE OWNERS SCOPE-OF-WORK WITH AN ADDITIONAL 10% CAPACITY. AIR HANDLING UNITS WILL BE WALL MOUNTED AND AIR COOLED CONDENSING UNITS WILL BE MOUNTED ON A CONCRETE PAD. THE UNITS SHALL BE CONTROLLED BY THE DDC SYSTEM.' General notes include 11 construction requirements. PE seal visible — Certificate No. 18267 (Virginia), dated 04/10/2023.

sheets.title: MECHANICAL PLAN – DEMOLITION
sheets.reading_notes: Floor plan at 1/4"=1'-0" scale showing Rooms F109 and F110 (F-Wing, CEBAF Center Building 12). Shows existing ductwork, diffusers, registers, and portable cooling unit (in Room F110) all tagged ETR (existing to remain) or for demolition. Demolition note: 'REMOVE EXISTING PORTABLE COOLING UNIT AND DUCTWORK. TURN OVER TO TR. PROVIDE AND INSTALL NEW MATCHING CEILING TILE AT CEILING PENETRATION.' Existing 12/10 supply and 17/10 return duct sizes visible. Room labels F109 and F110 confirmed. Existing cabinet units visible in F109.

sheets.title: MECHANICAL PLAN – NEW WORK
sheets.reading_notes: Floor plan showing new installation: two wall-mounted indoor split-system units (AHU-1 in F109, AHU-2 in F110), two outdoor air-cooled condensing units (ACCU-1, ACCU-2) on concrete pads outside building, condensate drain piping (3/4" PVC), refrigerant piping (suction and liquid line sets). Thermostats shown in each room per design requirements (new thermostats set 2°F above existing thermostat set points). DDC connection indicated.

sheets.title: DETAILS
sheets.reading_notes: Mechanical details sheet. Based on text extraction, likely includes refrigerant piping details, condensate drain details, equipment mounting details, and penetration details for outdoor line sets.

sheets.title: SCHEDULES AND CONTROLS
sheets.reading_notes: Equipment schedule and controls sheet. Based on text extraction, includes Daikin split system selection (FTXM18VVJU indoor / RXM18VVJU outdoor, 18 MBH each), BACnet DDC interface requirements, thermostat set point information, and Johnson Controls integration notes.

sheets.title: LEGEND, ABBREVIATIONS, SCHEDULES AND DETAILS
sheets.reading_notes: Electrical legend/abbreviations sheet. Contains: (1) Conduit-sleeve thru exterior wall detail (shows LFMC to RMC conduit transition, plastic waterproof cement, exterior wall penetration); (2) One-line diagram showing existing 225A, 208Y/120V panelboard 'RP1G' with new 2-pole 30A circuit breakers for two new condensing units (ACC-3 and ACC-4) plus existing AHU-16 circuit. New disconnect switches (30A, 2-pole, non-fused, NEMA 4X) shown exterior; (3) Panelboard RP1G schedule — before and after — showing new breakers added at positions 28 (12A) and 30 (15A) for new split system units. New circuits: 2-#12 and 1-#12 GND in 3/4" C. Designer RDW (Richard Williams). PE seal visible.

Shows new electrical circuits to indoor wall-mounted air handlers (AHU-15 in F109, AHU-16 in F110), routing of conduit through exterior wall to outdoor condensing units (ACC-3 and ACC-4 on concrete pads outside F-Wing). General notes and work notes on sheet per text extraction.
